basis: Reuse reviewed complete ABO render views and original TRAIN/DEV product roles. One requested object-family change or one studio-background color change; joint combines these two. No material, base, stem, lighting, brightness, window or room constraints in the user instruction. Genuine alpha is preserved. Source references with other shapes/patterns may remain references but are not falsely labelled as a replacement family. No holdout reads, model-based selection or GPU work.
target_policy: TRAIN family labels correspond to multiple product identities. Within a source product and requested family, the canonical replacement product is fixed independently of background to prevent a color-to-SKU side channel. Source and target product identities differ for object/joint. Identical reference RGB + prompt + seed must not map to conflicting GT. Targets are one supervised example of a family, not the only semantically valid output.
inference: Reference RGB + short instruction only. No target image, alpha, teacher caption or SKU.
holdout: The existing independent 240-pair complex-scene cohort remains unopened by models. A separately versioned simple-scene evaluation protocol must be prepared and frozen before final evaluation; never mix new-task scores with old-task scores.
